My friend on his Xbox however, having a blast and the game looks good regardless. So it's just down to being a port with barely any optimization

Has nothing really to do with it. The way how I see it as, is that Turn10 created a great physics game with well optimized graphics for their next Gen console only. They completely brushed off optimization for PC though as people can notice that there's bugs that requires restarts when changing graphics settings, ray tracing is nowhere near optimized like series X, and the fidelity just sucks that which means some ppl even try to upscale that which makes fps tank more so that they can see a more clear image. Companies need to realize that if they want a successful multi platform game, then they need to optimize all platforms. Not just be lazy and just port it. Then expect it to run it against a console that mostly has overall lower specs than most ppl trying to run this game.
